svg.title: Proposed HTTPS pilot portal with private Azure backend services
svg.desc: Not deployed. Browser uses Azure Container Apps public HTTPS and Microsoft Entra organizational login. The BFF retains server sessions and customer authorization, reaches private database, storage and keys, and sends opaque signals through the restricted public Service Bus Standard endpoint. No Bastion or VPN. Live identity, proxy, audit, image and priced session remain blocked.
svg.text: HTTPS pilot portal · accepted local design
ADR-0011 accepted for local templates · 2026-10-03 UTC · Not deployed
Azure East US2 candidate · new external environment + private VNet backend paths
Only portal / BFF has public HTTP ingress
HTTP redirects · exact origin / proxy proof
No tokens in ordinary browser JavaScript
Workers: no ingress / no public route targets
Azure Key Vault · dedicated wrapping key
Exact SQL / Blob / key / image scopes
Private DNS · no public database / vault / evidence
NAT Gateway + fixed egress public IP
Entra only · opaque signals · no evidence payloads
Local templates approved · public access / live sign-in disabled · G1–G9 NOT VERIFIED
The $50 monthly development allowance does not establish always-on affordability. No custom domain or paid edge selected.
Blue: application/data flow · Purple: identity/authority · Red dashed: internet boundary · Official Microsoft icons unmodified
